name: Community — MiniMax H3 (PinkCherry v1.8 Hybrid)
author: SexGod1979
description: MiniMax H3 on SexGod1979's PinkCherry v1.8 Hybrid: an adult fine-tune (the author publishes its explicit training captions), INT8, 21.1 GB, Apache-2.0. This card runs the author's full-step setting with no turbo LoRA: euler / simple, 30 steps. It is slow: about 19 minutes for a 15-second clip at 480p on a 12 GB card. In a one-seed check on a fully clothed stop-motion scene it behaved much like stock H3, so the fine-tune has not cost it general ability. The author trains at high resolution and recommends 0.7 megapixels or more; our test ran at 864x480 and held up. Text to video only in this first release. The author's faster route, the lightx2v 8-step turbo LoRA at 12 steps, is not offered here because we have not tested it.

presets.name: MiniMax H3 Text to Video (PinkCherry v1.8 Hybrid)
presets.description:
SexGod1979's PinkCherry v1.8 Hybrid (INT8, 21.1 GB) on the plain official graph at the author's full-step setting: euler / simple, 30 steps, no turbo LoRA. The author is explicit that the scheduler must be euler / simple, not beta or res_multistep.

An adult fine-tune: the author publishes its training captions and they are explicit. It has kept its general ability. One-seed comparison against eight other H3 checkpoints (2026-10-09, RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB, 864x480, 15 s, engine v0.38.0) on a fully clothed stop-motion scene: on plain prose it rendered much like stock H3, with one soft-focus eye where the prompt asked for it, and on a structured three-shot brief it cut at the scripted 5 and 10 second marks. One seed and one scene, so treat this as a first impression; the audio was not judged by ear.

Slow by design: about 19 minutes per 15-second clip at 480p. The author recommends 0.7 megapixels or higher (672p and up at 16:9); 480p worked in our test, and higher tiers cost more time and memory.

Free system RAM matters more than VRAM; keep 16 GB+ free.

Verified in SimpliGen 1.71.1 / engine v0.38.0 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti: 15 s at 864x480, 30 steps, 1133 s through the app, and the output matched the engine test frame for frame (same seed).
presets.tagline: PinkCherry v1.8 Hybrid at full steps: slow, clean, no LoRA

requirements.notes: One 21.1 GB INT8 checkpoint. Thirty steps by default, euler/simple, sigma shift 12.0 video / 3.0 audio (the author gives no shift figure; 12/3 is what we tested). No turbo LoRA: the author's 12-step route with the lightx2v 8-step turbo LoRA is untested here and not offered. Image and reference cards were added in 1.1.0 (2026-10-15). MEASURED 2026-10-09 (RTX 4070 Ti 12 GB, 31 GB RAM, 864x480, 15 s, engine 0.38.0, Faster Attention on, this card's graph submitted to the engine): 1128-1147 s per clip at 30 steps. The author recommends 0.7 MP or more; the 480p tier is the default here only because it is what was tested. IN-APP 2026-10-09 (SimpliGen 1.71.1): the same prompt and seed through this card took 1133 s and produced video and audio identical to the engine test.
